name: tomtom-maps-sdk-js
description: Build apps with the TomTom Maps SDK for JavaScript (@tomtom-org/maps-sdk). Use when working with TomTomMap setup (including the MapLibre web worker it registers for Vite builds, registerMapLibreWorker, and a map that stays blank under webpack, Next.js with Turbopack, or a re-bundling CDN because the worker doesn't load), MapLibre integration (map.mapLibreMap, and when to prefer SDK features over raw MapLibre), BaseMapModule (showing or hiding layer groups such as 3D buildings and road shields, and road markings such as arrows and exit numbers) and its settings as data with baseMapKnobCatalogue, setting, reading and resetting any module knob by id with setKnob, setKnobs, getKnob and resetKnob (StylingFoundationsModule and MapEffects too) and when to use them rather than applyConfig and updateConfig and checking a value with validateKnobValue, TerrainModule (hillshade and its look, 3D terrain elevation and exaggeration, every setting as data with terrainKnobCatalogue), and viewport utilities; geopolitical views of disputed territories and borders (the global `geopoliticalView`, `geopoliticalViews`, setGeopoliticalView); map styles, standard style IDs (standardStyleIDs, streetLight, streetDark, streetLightDriving, streetDarkDriving, monoLight, monoDark, streetSatellite), setStyle and StyleChangeHandler, style switcher; semantic map styling with StylingFoundationsModule (label/icon/road size knobs, the typeface of every map label from the style's serif and italic faces or your own font files with labels.customTypeface, globe projection and sky, the stylingFoundationsKnobCatalogue, while the POI, traffic and hillshade looks sit on POIsModule, the traffic modules and TerrainModule; map presets with applyMapPreset and mapPresetCatalogue; reading any style colour by its map-wide id with getStyleColor and styleColorKnobIds; theming the map from a website's colours, a CSS stylesheet, an image, a palette description or an artist's style with the map-theme plugin's deriveMapColors, mapColorsLightDark, deriveMapColorsFromCss and deriveMapColorsFromImage, and the accent colour routes, geometries and places follow — colors.accent, map.mapColors), recolouring the base map with setMapColors and exporting the result with exportStyle, and the map-effects plugin (bloom and its bloom.only colour scope, tint, grade, vignette, fog, depth of field, capture, and your own GLSL passes with addPass); flying a camera along a route with the flyover plugin (RouteFlyover, aim ahead, junction framing, terrain clearance, where the followed position sits on screen with anchorForPitch, the marker that follows the route with setMarker); user interaction events (click, hover, contextmenu, recently-hovered, changing their timings with updateEventsConfig), selecting and highlighting features yourself and reading which are selected with setEventState, clearEventStates and getEventStates on every data-owned module and module lifecycle events, and saving and replaying a module's display configuration as JSON (the *SerializableConfig types); search, geocoding, reverse geocoding, autocomplete, search-box suggestions of places, brands and categories with getSearchSuggestions(), discovering places with discoverPlaces() (categories in words with filters.poiCategoryQuery, or resolved first with resolvePOICategories) and place details with getPlaceDetails(), places and POIs (PlacesModule and its markerType, color and label, where its pins and connections sit in the layer stack with PlacesBeforeLayerConfig, every places setting as data with placesKnobCatalogue, POIsModule and poisKnobCatalogue, custom icons and pins per POI category on the map's own POIs and on shown places with categoryIcons), clustering them with the pin-clustered marker type, drawing their entry points, which results PlacesModule.show() takes and what it adds to them (preparePlacesForDisplay), and a popup or result card on a clicked place, fuzzy, geometry and along-route search, all through discoverPlaces (route, maxDetourTimeSeconds, sortBy), search filters and cursor pagination, geographic bias with geoBias, and EV charging stations (charging stations, charging points and connectors on search results); routing and calculateRoute (RoutingModule), the route's color, widthPreset, widthFactor, waypoints.sizePreset and waypoints.sizeFactor, waypoint pins per role (start, stop, finish), stop numbering in numbers or letters, waypoint labels and hover growth, waypoint icons of your own or a POI category pin per stop, waypoints versus places (who draws a route's stops), every routing setting as data with routingKnobCatalogue, route alternatives, which vehicle and truck parameters routing accepts, turn-by-turn guidance instructions, route sections including toll and charged roads, ringing a leg or any section from your UI with setSectionFocus, speed limits and the tunnel and closed-to-vehicles signs, border crossings between country sections, and reachable ranges (isochrones) with ReachableRangesModule, its bands coloured from the map's accent and land or your own palette, every setting as data with reachableRangesKnobCatalogue; GeometriesModule (color, your own fill colours with fill.palette, fill.style, label, lineLabel, every setting as data with geometriesKnobCatalogue); traffic flow, incidents in a bbox or a polygon and their icons (isIconsVisible), planned incidents (timeValidity) and the highlight of a focused or hovered incident (IncidentHighlightConfig), and area analytics, and their settings as data with trafficAreaAnalyticsKnobCatalogue and the other traffic knob catalogues; custom GeoJSON layers and bring-your-own-data (CustomGeoJSONModule, BYOD, its settings as data with customGeoJSONKnobCatalogue); and the agent-toolkit plugin for conversational map agents (createMapAgent, LLM tools, custom tools with locatePlace and getViewportBias, the user's location precision with createGetCurrentLocationTool, Vercel AI SDK). Also covers core Place/Route types, service config, cancelling in-flight service calls with an AbortSignal and keeping only the latest one with createLatestRequest (search-as-you-type, refetch on map move, stale responses, race conditions, debounced input) and the SDKError/SDKServiceError/SDKAbortError classes and their SDKErrorCode codes (a 401 rejected key versus a 403 key not allowed an API or domain, and the Private Preview access such as Calculate Reachable Range that a key lacks), map failures (TomTomMapError, addErrorHandler, WebGL unsupported or context lost, rejected API key), and utilities such as bboxFromGeoJSON, bboxFromCoordsArray, isBBoxWithArea, getPosition, formatDistance, and formatDuration. Before integrating any SDK feature in Public Preview or Private Preview, plugins included (every plugin below 1.0.0 is in Public Preview), it shows the developer a preview notice and asks them to confirm. At the start of SDK work, it offers the developer the tomtom-maps-sdk-js-feedback skill, which reports what the SDK got wrong to TomTom with the developer's consent.
